author: Hotate / hotate-design
status: Authored and browser-exercised design input; not native acceptance

mergeOrder: light only when resolved mode is Light
authority.exporter: tools/build_tokens.py, unchanged canonical exporter imported by build.py

selection.system: Resolve from current OS day/night; react to later OS changes, keep selected System
selection.explicit: Ignore later OS brightness; preserve chosen Light or Dark
selection.acceptedWrite: Commit accepted selection immediately after successful local write; no delayed color animation
selection.failedWrite: Keep prior accepted choice and resolved palette. Inline error and explicit retry of failed choice. No background retry
selection.initialRead: Read before publishing persisted choice; on failure keep currently accepted choice, or System if none, show reload. Do not overwrite corrupted/unread data automatically
selection.migration: Existing valid Dark remains Dark; newly absent/out-of-range values use System. Do not infer Flutter numeric persistence ordinals from native enum order; use explicit native stable serialization.

AppearanceChoiceSheet.selected: Radio semantics plus filled indicator and check; whole row target >=48dp
AppearanceChoiceSheet.keyboard: Arrow/Home/End selects; Tab stays in sheet; Escape closes; restore opener focus
AppearanceChoiceSheet.commit: Selection does not dismiss sheet or remount route

PersistentPlayer.reference: Only synthetic transport intent, no audio

LibraryQueuePreview.purpose: Populated color composition, not another library repository

roles.components: component.* aliases must resolve in the same selected mode, not retain static dark references
roles.waveform: Base=textMuted; beat=secondary; playhead/cue=primary; deck=surface; origin=text. Selection is a 2dp boundary, NOT an opaque fill hiding waveforms. Use markers/labels/dash geometry to distinguish cue/origin/beat; keep existing data and dimensions. Browser packet does not qualify native waveform paint.
roles.rowReveal: secondary surface with background ink; no playback operations on mode change
roles.disabled: Explicit disabled text/background/border, never opacity-multiply enabled text
roles.rules: borderInput for meaningful control boundaries; subtleBorder is decorative only. Dark border/subtleBorder remain accepted W5 decorative rules, not new 3:1 claims.

motion.appearance: Immediate mode paint without whole-screen crossfade; preserve active pointer/focus and sheet lifecycle
motion.interruption: Changing preference/OS must not exit/reenter sheet or reset row/swipe controller

nativeIntegration.mapping: Use a CompositionLocal resolved SoundQModeColors; make SoundQ.colors a composable read instead of static singleton. Supply explicit lightColorScheme/darkColorScheme from resolved roles for Material hosts, not Material defaults/dynamic color. Existing font/spacing/motion tokens unchanged.
nativeIntegration.os: Read isSystemInDarkTheme() at theme boundary, resolve(choice, systemDark), never store resolved brightness as choice
nativeIntegration.state: Store stable device-local accepted choice in existing preference owner; maintain single playback service and retain route keys. Wire native Back to existing sheet dismissal.
nativeIntegration.acceptanceOwner: Ebi/native implementation owner; must compile, exercise persistence/restart, actual OS changes, native accessibility and player continuity separately

limits: No actual OS brightness delivery or Android storage tested
No audio decoding, accounts or backend
Initial preference read error specified only, not simulated in reference
